clips.title: The story
paras: Twilight Whiskers are harvested from twilight runners prowling the northern heights of the Stonetalon Mountains. In the settlement of Malaka'jin, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil covets them as an ingredient in a cruel, venomous concoction he mockingly names forest magic.

The high crags near Stonetalon Peak are home to twilight runners, predatory felines attuned to the deep shadows of the ancient groves. While hunters prize their pelts, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil of Malaka'jin seeks their stiff whiskers for a far darker purpose. Seeking vengeance upon captured night elves who once defended these woodlands, Jin'Zil gathers components of the forest—resinous sap, countless eyes, fey dragon scales, and twilight whiskers—to brew a lethal draught intended to mock and poison his captives.
